scope_review.sentence: A retained object census over two named storage prefixes finds no multi-frame coordinate file, so the corrected-interface readouts cannot be recomputed.
scope_review.why: the ABSENCE is correctly bounded ('over two named storage prefixes'), but the CONSEQUENCE that follows it is stated without bound. §9.4 explicitly bounds the same conclusion ('a retrospective one about the surveyed prefixes, not a proof about every possible external copy of the data') and §10.5 item 4 bounds it too ('from what was retained under the surveyed prefixes'). The abstract is the one place the qualifier is dropped, and the abstract is the part a reader quotes.
scope_review.supported_form: cannot be recomputed FROM WHAT THOSE TWO PREFIXES RETAIN
scope_review.not_a_softening: the negative is unchanged - no trajectory exists in either surveyed prefix, the readouts are not recomputable from retained data, and the two legs that simulated the wrong tether remain unrepairable by any retained data. Only the reach of the sentence is brought back to the evidence.

scope_review.sentence: The requirement R4 has no in-silico instrument in this program; a bench measurement is the only answer.
scope_review.why: read alone, 'the only answer' is a claim about all computation, which this record cannot support. But the same item carries, two sentences later, an explicit bound: 'Stated as this program's position and not as a theorem about all computation', and §10.6 restates it scoped ('cannot be answered by this program's instruments'). The bound is present and adjacent, so no edit is proposed. Recorded so the parent can judge, not silently dropped.

scope_review.sentence: the released-case coordinate comparison and primary protocol statement that such a claim would require were not identified in the retained evidence used here
scope_review.why: the R3 revision already replaced a repository-wide phrasing with an inspected-evidence one and says so in place. This is the defect class this lane looks for, already repaired by the earlier accepted batch.

each carries an explicit withdrawal of the earlier universal reading: 'not a demonstration that nothing binds this pocket', 'It is not established that no discriminating contact of any kind exists', 'not a measured biological false-positive rate ... does not exclude a design class', and 'no control EXISTS' is stated per-instrument (V9, V14, V16) rather than as a claim about controls in general.

'The claim that no known-answer test can catch these defects is withdrawn' - the record supports only that the EXISTING tests did not, and the manuscript makes exactly that distinction and then lists the tests that would.

supersession_review._method: read the FINDING.md of each named sibling lane and asked, for each, whether it OVERTURNS a failure PUB-METHODS records, NARROWS it, or is orthogonal.
supersession_review._result_headline: NO recorded failure of PUB-METHODS is overturned by any of the five lanes. One is independently STRENGTHENED.
